## News provided by
**Spark Perceptions Technology Inc.**
Aug 04, 2026, 08:42 ET

...

## Share this article
BOSTON , Aug. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In a cannabis hardware market dominated by dry herb vaporizers, glass pieces, and portable accessories, Boston-based Spark Perceptions Technology is taking a different approach.

...

Its flagship product, the EZUP Aurora, is designed as an automated dry herb device for adult consumers in legal markets. Unlike vape pens or oil cartridges, Aurora is not sold with nicotine, THC, cannabis, or any plant material. It is a reusable hardware device built to automate the dry herb session itself.

...

Spark Perceptions believes the long-term opportunity extends beyond a single product. As adult-use markets mature, cannabis hardware is likely to become smarter, cleaner, and easier to use.

...

With EZUP Aurora, the company aims to establish a new standard for automated dry herb consumption—one that reduces repetitive manual work, improves session efficiency, and makes combustion-based use feel more like a modern appliance than a traditional smoking tool.
